newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB shares recover from day's lows.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB shares recover from day's lows.

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting Plc clawed back some of the initial losses on Friday, as fears over a fresh competition probe were allayed by comments from the European Union's competition commissioner late yesterday.
The stock was down 5-1/2p at 591 by 1154 GMT, after initially dropping to 570p.

BSkyB late on Thursday said the EU's Karel van Miert was monitoring a television rights deal between the satellite broadcaster and the English Football Association, but had not called for a formal investigation into it.
Earlier on Thursday Van Miert said in a BBC interview: "We have to look into the BSkyB-Premiership contract and also the duration of the contract."
BSkyB shares were also unsettled today by continuing worries over News Corp's plan to mortgage part of its stake in Sky as part of a $1 billion debt issue.
